text:
Asha: Heads up — support flagged a customer (CUST-4912) seeing spikes of 5xx and timeouts against hosted inference in us-west-2 since ~09:10 UTC. @support-bot opened an incident. Can oncall ack?

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026; severity=high; notified #incidents and oncall.

Ben: Acked. Customer reports repeated 504s and stalled streaming responses. P99 latency shot up. Sharing customer's repro:```curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","prompt":"hello"}'``` Logs show request IDs: req_8f3a, req_8f3b.

Jia: On it. Any deploys or config changes around 09:00?

Marco: No infra deploys to the inference fleet at 09:00. We did push a proxy config to the edge at 08:55 (conn pool defaults bumped). I'm rolling that change back now.

Leah: Observed high connection queues on gateway-02 and a burst of KV cache 429s -> downstream backpressure. Inference pool has capacity but request queue grew and timed out.

Asha: Mitigation plan: Marco to rollback proxy change (in progress). Jia, please apply a temporary routing rule to divert traffic away from gateway-02 to gateway-04. Ben, set customer expectations.

Ben: Told customer we identified a congested gateway and are rolling back a recent proxy tweak + routing around the node. ETA 15-30m. CSM on standby — customer marked as "blocked".

Marco: Rollback completed at 09:22 UTC on gateway-02. Connection counts are dropping, error rate starting to fall. Applying warm-up route to gateway-04 now.

Jia: Routing rule applied at 09:25 UTC. Still seeing ~1% residual errors from long-tail clients. Hypothesis: prefix KV cache misses causing stall on initial token generation. I'm enabling more aggressive prefix caching and lowering batch size for the affected model temporarily.

Leah: After routing + rollback + cache tweak, p99 fell from ~4.2s to ~320ms and 5xx rate dropped to <0.1%. Keeping elevated monitoring for 30m.

Asha: Good work. Action items for follow-up/postmortem: 1) Review and gate proxy config rollouts (Marco) 2) Add per-gateway circuit breakers + automated routing fallback (Jia/Leah) 3) Improve alerts for queue length and kv-cache 429s (Leah) 4) Create runbook for routing bypass + customer comms (Jia/Ben). Please confirm owners & ETAs.

Jia: I'll own the runbook and the temporary batch-size tuning PR. ETA: EOD for runbook, config PR tomorrow AM.

Marco: I'll open an infra PR to require canary + traffic-shift for proxy config changes, and add a rollback test. ETA: 2 business days.

Ben: I'll draft the customer-facing RCA and timeline. Will sync with CSM. ETA: 24 hours.

Leah: I'll add the queue-length/kvcache alerts and tune thresholds. ETA: tomorrow.

Asha: :thumbsup: Closing immediate mitigation. Filing follow-up ticket INC-2026-FUP for postmortem and owners. If anyone finds additional logs or a specific client that reproduces the long-tail error, drop them into INC-2026-FUP.

support-bot: Incident INC-2026 updated: status=mitigated, severity downgraded to low, follow-up ticket INC-2026-FUP created.

Ben: Customer reported reduced errors and appreciates quick response. They'll wait for RCA.

Jia: I'll attach relevant flamegraphs and request traces to the follow-up ticket.

Marco: Adding proxy rollout checklist to the PR description.

Leah: Will monitor for 2 hours then shift to regular alerts.

Asha: Thanks team. Postmortem owner assigned: Jia. Deadline: draft PM by EOD tomorrow.
